name: UK terrorism threat level
summary: UK national threat level Severe: an attack is highly likely
state: The UK national terrorism threat level has been Severe, meaning an attack is highly likely, since JTAC raised it from Substantial on 30 Apr 2026 (MI5; GOV.UK). No change had been announced as of 4 Nov.
for_you: Follow MI5 and police guidance: stay alert in crowded places and report suspicious activity to police.
